name: noogie
tagline: A news aggregator that summarizes stories from many outlets in a node map to show every side.
problem: Readers get trapped in bubbles that only confirm their views.
solution: Collects articles from multiple sources, summarizes them with AI, and shows perspectives as an interactive cluster graph.
demo_moment: Team-described: open a story cluster and compare how outlets frame it.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won best design with a node-cluster view of the news.

lessons: A distinctive visual metaphor can win a design prize on its own.
